parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, which is lightweight and flexible.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain balance and comfort.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, providing flexibility and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the glasses in place on the wearer’s head and ensures stability during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for compact storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame Front)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame front of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic, which holds the lenses and connects to the legs.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the lenses and provides the structural integrity of the eyeglasses, ensuring proper alignment and vision correction.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support structure for the entire eyeglass assembly.
